description: Get public details for a specific venue (soccer field or pickleball court) in a JoGo.Team city, including a Google Maps directions link and the page URL where all upcoming games at that location are listed. The result carries a sport field; pass sport for a court of another sport, and omit it for soccer.

sport.description: Optional sport to search: soccer, pickleball, padel, squash. Omit for soccer, the default.

venue_slug.description: Venue URL slug (e.g. 'silver-lake-park'), as found in a venue page URL or list_games result.

name: get_venue
